target.title: feat: clarify iOS Location Always permission flow
target.body:
Related: #99229
Related: #86217

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where iOS users could select Location Always in OpenClaw without the app clearly explaining whether iOS had actually granted background-capable location access. That made wake-up/location workflows ambiguous, especially when iOS only allowed While Using, denied access, or global Location Services were disabled.

## Why This Change Was Made

This draft adds an explicit iOS permission summary for Location settings that separates the user's selected OpenClaw mode from the effective iOS authorization state. It also wires the background-location contract into the native configuration and location service path: background updates are only enabled for Always-capable use, and significant-change monitoring is stopped when the mode is disabled or downgraded.

This is intentionally a draft for product/privacy/design review. It follows the current SettingsProTab pattern for now because #99231 may reshape the Settings UI.

## User Impact

Users get clearer feedback when Location Always is selected but iOS has not granted background-capable permission. Operators and reviewers also get a cleaner contract for when the iOS app may use background location behavior.

Use cases covered in this draft:

- Keep OpenClaw reachable for location-triggered/background wake-up workflows when the user explicitly selects Always and iOS grants Always.
- Show a warning when Always is selected but iOS only grants While Using, so users understand background location will not work.
- Show a warning when location is denied, restricted, or globally disabled in iOS settings.
- Stop background/significant-change monitoring when the user turns Location off or downgrades away from Always.

## Evidence

- `pnpm native:i18n:check` passed (`entries=2384 changed=false`).
- Targeted SwiftFormat lint passed for the changed Location/Settings/test files.
- Targeted SwiftLint passed for the changed Location/Settings/test files. Note: targeted lint including `NodeAppModel.swift` still reports the existing unrelated cyclomatic-complexity warning around `connectToGateway`; the Xcode test build's lint phase passed.
- `git diff --check --cached && git diff --check` passed before commit.
- Focused simulator tests passed: `OpenClawTests/LocationPermissionSummaryTests` on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5, 7 tests.
- Built simulator app Info.plist includes `UIBackgroundModes = [audio, location, remote-notification]`.
- Local Codex review findings were accepted/fixed for global Location Services handling, extractor-visible i18n strings, background update enabling, Location Off cleanup, significant-change monitor stop-on-downgrade, and duplicate warning copy.

No physical-device proof yet; this is a draft review PR for tomorrow if still needed.
